report_title: # P0009 ARC3 Learned Mechanics / Level-Progress Packet
claim_boundary: This source-pinned replay experiment evaluates whether the shared compatibility core can infer a bounded public action-motion relation and select actions that contribute to one recorded ARC3 level transition. It does not claim a general ARC3 solver, ARC-AGI-1 solver, or ARC-AGI-2 solver. The controller receives only prior public transitions, a current public frame, and currently available actions; it receives no future action sequence, simulator, post-hoc rule, oracle diff, or reasoning annotation.

public_history.contract: Only recorded transitions strictly before the initial live cursor are supplied as history. The initial cursor and all future records remain adapter-private.
